newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound strengthens against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound strengthens against dollar.

text.p: Demand for the Egyptian pound helped it strengthen against the dollar in the private sector market on Sunday, bankers said.
"There are lots of offers. Many people are offering dollars," said one banker.
"The pound is strengthening because there are too many offers on the other side," said another banker.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3920 and 3.3950 bid and at between 3.3935 and 3.3970 offered in the interbank market.
The average rate on Sunday was 3.39125 bid and 3.394875 offered. These averages compare to 3.39325 pounds bid and 3.395625 pounds offered on Thursday.
One banker said demand for the pound could probably be tied to the fact that the Central Bank was accepting treasury bill tenders.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.389513 buy and 3.395873 sell.
